scope: Builder-created control- and fit-point splines, shared 3D area merging, and XY spatial selection.
validation: Before the fix, builder-created control- and fit-point spline bounding boxes were at the origin, selected at the origin, and not selected around their true location.
Both constructors now reuse the existing spline bounds calculation; both Area merge overloads retain Z min/max while XY predicates remain unchanged.
Eight focused spline and area tests pass with bundled and current shared codecs, including 3D box extents and positive/negative selection.
Thirty-eight geometry tests and six bundled and ten shared HATCH/MPOLYGON controls pass.
limitations: Headless macOS ARM64 only; native GUI, hosted CI, and other platforms remain open.
Area predicates and selection remain two-dimensional; this change only preserves stored Z extents. Current shared-codec build uses scratch CMake glue.
